description: Notion task tracking integration system enabling programmatic task management via Notion API
current_features: Create tasks in Notion database with title, assignee, and notes
Update task status and notes for existing tasks
Basic error handling with console logging

createTask.purpose: Creates a new task in Notion database

updateTask.purpose: Updates existing task status and notes

main.purpose: Example usage demonstrating task creation and update

functional.description: System shall create tasks in Notion database with title, assignee, and notes
System shall update task status and notes in Notion database
System should retrieve and list tasks from Notion database
System should retrieve individual task by ID
System should filter tasks by status
System should filter tasks by assignee
System should filter tasks by date range
System should archive tasks from Notion database
System should support batch creation of multiple tasks
System should support batch updates of multiple tasks
System shall handle API errors gracefully with detailed logging

non_functional.description: System shall use environment variables for sensitive configuration
System shall validate required environment variables at startup
System shall retry failed API calls with exponential backoff
System shall handle rate limiting from Notion API
Code shall follow modular design with reusable functions
System shall use custom error types for better error handling
System shall validate input parameters before API calls
System shall validate Notion database schema compatibility
System shall have comprehensive documentation with usage examples

ambiguous_requirements.question: What is the expected behavior when Notion API rate limits are hit?
ambiguous_requirements.suggested_clarification: Define retry strategy, backoff intervals, and maximum retry attempts for rate limit scenarios

ambiguous_requirements.question: Should the system support batch operations for multiple tasks?
ambiguous_requirements.suggested_clarification: Specify if bulk create/update operations are needed and define batch size limits

ambiguous_requirements.question: What are the complete database schema requirements for the Notion database?
ambiguous_requirements.suggested_clarification: Document all required and optional Notion database properties, field types, and validation rules

ambiguous_requirements.question: Should assignedTo support multiple assignees or only single assignment?
ambiguous_requirements.suggested_clarification: Clarify if tasks can be assigned to multiple people or single person only

ambiguous_requirements.question: What status values are valid beyond 'To-do' and 'Done'?
ambiguous_requirements.suggested_clarification: Define complete enumeration of valid status values (e.g., In Progress, Blocked, Cancelled)

required_env_vars.name: NOTION_API_KEY
required_env_vars.description: Notion integration API key for authentication

required_env_vars.name: NOTION_DATABASE_ID
required_env_vars.description: Target Notion database ID for task storage
